scientific.integrity: The lower bound is analytic: exact root-of-unity moment identities and a nonnegative quartic certificate force the peak. The finite numerical replay is corroborative only.
scientific.limitations: The theorem evaluates one fixed-unimodular sampled minimax problem on the seven-point cyclic group; it does not classify every minimizing phase pair and does not determine the Sidon constant.

title: Exact seven-sample phase minimax for the Fano frequency triple
